title: You blink about 15,000 times a day 👁️ #shorts
description:
Adults blink about 15–20 times a minute — roughly 15,000 times in a waking day. Each blink lasts about a tenth of a second, and every one spreads a fresh tear film over your eye. When you read or stare at a screen, it can drop to 3–4 blinks a minute.
Math: 15/min × 960 waking minutes ≈ 14,400.
Sources: American Academy of Ophthalmology; UCL (blink duration 100–150 ms); Wikipedia 'Blinking' (reading 3–4/min).

Inner Numbers — your body, counted. New Short every day.
Educational content, not medical advice.

scenes.say: You'll blink around fifteen thousand times today.
Fifteen to twenty times every minute, and you barely notice.
Each blink lasts about a tenth of a second.
And every blink spreads a fresh film of tears, in layers, across your eye.
But when you read or stare at a screen, it can drop to three or four a minute.
That's why your eyes feel dry right now. Blink. Follow for more of your body, counted.
